name: Bright Vintage
description: A warm, light analog design system inspired by 70s hardware synthesizers. Brushed aluminum panels, walnut wooden knobs, silk-screened monospace labels, and glowing amber LEDs. Rooted in Korg MS-20 / Roland SH-1000 / ARP 2600 hardware with clean modern layout structure.
